# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c4 P44](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0044), [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy Gardner is an exceptionally handsome and distinguished-looking young man with dark, melancholy, inscrutable eyes, a fine, clean-shaven chin, and a melting, musical voice. He possesses a remarkably dark, velvety smile and a graceful, courtly manner that leaves a strong impression. Anne Shirley notes that he matches the exact physical type of her romantic ideal.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020), [v3 c35 P6](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0006), [v3 c36 P28](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0028)_

## Personality

Roy is polite, romantic, and deeply devoted when courting, often expressing his feelings through poetry and elaborate compliments. He is known to be sweet-natured, though lacking in a sense of humor and a bit uninteresting behind his polished exterior. He tends to fall intensely in love and feels his rejections deeply, though he eventually recovers and moves on to new romance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031), [v3 c27 P32](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0032), [v3 c33 P5](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0005), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P29](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0029), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002), [v3 c39 P5](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0005)_

## Goals

- To win the hand and affection of Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Roy Gardner originally attended Redmond College for his Freshman and Sophomore years, but paused his studies to accompany his mother to Europe for two years due to her failing health. Upon returning to Redmond as a Junior, he rescued Anne Shirley in the rain under a collapsed umbrella, marking the beginning of their courtship. He wooed Anne attentively over two years with flowers, compliments, and poetry, earning the acceptance of her friends and eventually his own family. After their graduation, Roy proposed to Anne in the harbor pavilion at Kingsport where they first met, but she unexpectedly rejected his proposal upon realizing she did not truly love him. Though deeply hurt and believing his life ruined at the time, Roy eventually recovered from the heartbreak and later married another woman.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P46](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0046), [v3 c36 P20](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0020), [v3 c37 P10](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0010), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P23](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0023), [v3 c38 P29](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0029), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)_
